changes.author_statement: Corrected GSE194378, GSE199750 and GSE276544 expression files.
V2 updates GSE169159; adds GSE230494 antibodies and metadata; adds gene/time summaries and variable definitions.
V3 removes bulk_gene_expr_raw; adds study_citations and dataset DOI/CC-BY-4.0.

version_cautions.finding: May 2026 paper describes raw files redistributed; August 2026 V3 says raw source expression files were removed. Use current file inventory and source-record links.
Current HF study_meta has 16 columns including gene/time summaries; current GitHub study_meta has 13 columns. Both have 66 rows. They are not interchangeable snapshots.
Current downloaded HF example metadata has 387 rows and 73 distinct subjects; antibody has 73 rows. Card says 386/72. These are examples, not full study totals.
README X count claim and paper/demo transformations do not establish every current H5AD layer. Per-artifact inspection required.
Retained in current study_meta despite removal of raw-expression folder; do not treat as a resolved availability status.
README offers revision=script, whereas inventory is main revision. Pin exact revisions; no remote loader code executed in this audit.

limits: This lane audits HR-VILAGE documentation, code and small tables. It is not a census of all influenza challenge studies.
Author count 3178 does not prove 3178 distinct independent persons after paired modalities, repeated challenges or cross-source duplication.
Same research group and similar pipelines do not prove negligible batch effects.
Study citations locate records, not a verified complete list of retrievable raw assets.
